heading: Proof of rent arrears
paragraphs: You must provide proof of how the rent arrears have built up over time. You can upload a rent statement, or create one now.
A bank statement will not be accepted. A rent statement must show:
bullets: every date when a payment was supposed to be made
the amount that was due on each of those dates
the payments that were made, and when they were made
the running total of rent arrears
afterBullets: It must cover the time from the first date the defendants missed a payment, or the last 2 years of payments if the first missed payment was more than 2 years ago.
